model: 24 in. x 36 in. x 0.118 in. foam PVC board, 5-pack

source.title: Home Depot listing for Komatex foam project board 5-pack

stiffness_note: Kommerling's Komatex data sheet prints apparent density 0.55 to 0.65 g/cm3 (DIN 53 479) and modulus of elasticity 850 to 1100 N/mm2 (DIN 53 457), as standard values for an average density; small variations with thickness are possible. At 0.118 in. this board is far thinner than a speaker wall, so it suits panels and baffles, not a whole box.
